plan: Deep-copy and validate the workspace tree using recursive traversal and an ID index.
Centralize depth-first item walking for word counts, unresolved-marker collection, outline rendering, and move lookup.
Make moves atomic by applying them to a candidate deep copy and committing only after every validation succeeds.
mechanisms: Recursive schema validation with globally unique item IDs
Compiled regular expressions for exact marker removal/extraction and word counting
Deep-copy boundaries at construction and serialization
